data.name: Ozias
data.long_meaning: Ozias is a Hebrew name derived from the root words 'Azah' (help) and 'Yah' (God). It is used in the Old Testament to name several individuals, including King Ozias of Judah and the prophet Azariah. In the Bible, Ozias is described as a man of faith and obedience who ruled Judah and carried out temple reforms. The name symbolizes God's help and support in a person's life.
